title: Clarify SDK authority when Directory.Build.props is above the indexed workspace
outcome: The supported SDK-context authority boundary is explicit for repositories indexed from a subdirectory.
acceptance: A focused fixture demonstrates the repo/src workspace layout with repo/Directory.Build.props overriding UsingNETSdkDefaults=false and a central version depending on that flag; distinguish indexed behavior from native MSBuild.

Document or expose the resulting authority limitation, or design explicitly admitted parent-project authority with matching invalidation; do not silently read outside the selected workspace or change numeric budgets.
